related.title: ICESat-2 雷射測高衛星
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付面積、水厚、質量帳及成分分離條件，不把總儲水全歸地下水。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver area, thickness, mass ledger and separation assumptions without assigning all change to groundwater.
related.difference: 在重複軌跡分析中扣除橫向偏移遇到地表坡度造成的假高度變化。
related.differenceEn: Remove apparent elevation change caused by cross-track displacement over sloping terrain in repeat-track analysis.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 依次換 km² 到 m²、kg 到 Gt，反算水厚核對。
先算坡度項 0.4 m，再從觀測 0.5 m 扣除，與剖面圖交叉核對。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Convert km² to m² and kg to Gt, then invert the calculation to recover thickness.
Compute the 0.4 m terrain term, subtract it from 0.5 m and cross-check against the profile.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: TESS 系外行星巡天
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付面積、水厚、質量帳及成分分離條件，不把總儲水全歸地下水。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver area, thickness, mass ledger and separation assumptions without assigning all change to groundwater.
related.difference: 計算鄰星混光對凌日深度的稀釋，規劃質心與孔徑比較驗證。
related.differenceEn: Calculate transit-depth dilution from a neighbouring star and plan centroid/aperture checks.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 依次換 km² 到 m²、kg 到 Gt，反算水厚核對。
從觀測損失 0.008×1000=8 單位回推目標深度，再與公式核對。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Convert km² to m² and kg to Gt, then invert the calculation to recover thickness.
Infer target depth from observed loss 0.008×1000=8 units and cross-check the formula.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
